ambiguity_resolubility.fragment: Shut off the pumps if the water level remains above 100 meters for more than 4 seconds.
missing_information: A specific threshold duration beyond which the pump shutdown is triggered (e.g., exactly five or six seconds).
ambiguity_resolubility.justification: The requirement text provides no explicit definition of what constitutes 'more than four seconds' and no context to infer a precise boundary.
